extracted.name: Traci’s Adobo Seasoning
extracted.description: This adobo seasoning made with simple pantry herbs and spices is easy to make and adds savory flavoring to chicken, fish, meat, and cottage cheese.
instruction_lines: Stir together salt, paprika, black pepper, onion powder, oregano, cumin, garlic powder, and chili powder in a bowl.
Store in a sealed jar in a cool, dry place.
